description: This PHP class represents a stack used in formula parsing within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for stack operations such as push, pop, and peek, and manages branch pruning states during formula calculation.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: A class implementing a parser stack for formula processing, with branch pruning support.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new entry onto the stack with type, value, and optional reference; handles locale-specific function names.

methods.name: pushStackItem
methods.description: Pushes a pre-formed stack item onto the stack.

methods.name: getStackItem
methods.description: Constructs a stack item array with type, value, and reference, adding branch pruning context.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last item from the stack.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the n-th item from the top without removing it.
